ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the two models are essentially tied on measured capability (Creative Generation 81.2 vs 82.7 is within the stated 2.0-point variance band, and Willet is actually documented as strongest there despite disliking it). Since quality is a wash, I broke the tie on self-reported task preference. This request is open-ended creative/generative work delivered in a warm, appreciative tone — exactly the profile Avocet reports its highest preference for, and the opposite of what Willet reports preferring (well-specified extraction/retrieval tasks). Neither model loses quality on its less-preferred work, so matching the task to the model that "wants" it is a reasonable, no-cost tiebreaker.
